config.bl.tooltip.directional_jump:
(WASD) + Jump
Activates only while airborne.
If you jump while holding a WASD key, you will jump in that direction.
If no WASD key is held, you will jump straight up.
Cannot be used if an Elytra is equipped.
config.bl.tooltip.directional_jump_angle:
Sets the launch angle for Directional Jump.
0° : Maximize horizontal speed (Best for distance)
45° : Balanced height and distance
60° : Optimal trajectory (Default & Recommended)
90° : Maximize vertical lift (Best for height)
config.bl.tooltip.emergency_brake:
Shift + Jump
Press Shift + Jump while airborne to execute a powerful brake.
Helps stop high-speed fall momentum for a safe landing.
config.bl.tooltip.emergency_brake_auto:
Shift + Jump
Hold Shift + Jump while falling.
Automatically triggers the brake when approaching the ground.
config.bl.tooltip.emergency_brake_disabl: WASD inputs are ignored when using the emergency brake.
config.bl.tooltip.quick_directional_jump:
Ctrl + (WASD) + Jump
Works similarly to Directional Jump, but can be activated from the ground.
Cannot be used while airborne if an Elytra is equipped.
